$schema-note: The chat module's design-token contract. Stored as JSON so BOTH the node encapsulation guard (scripts/check-chat-encapsulation.mjs) and the vitest portability/guard tests read it natively — no TS loader, no regex parsing of a .ts source. The `description` field carries the doc this format cannot express as comments.
description: The exhaustive set of CSS custom properties (design tokens) the chat module (web/console/src/lib/chat/) depends on. The chat module is a self-contained component library that, per D-091, must render WITHOUT the Console's app shell or global stylesheet — a second framework surface (the packed dev UI named by D-091 / brief 12) mounts it supplying ONLY this contract. Every token here MUST resolve in web/console/src/lib/tokens.css (the single token surface). The encapsulation guard fails CI two ways: (1) a `var(--…)` used in the chat module that is absent from this list (an undeclared dependency — extend the contract AND confirm it resolves in tokens.css), or (2) a token listed here that no longer resolves in tokens.css (a broken contract). Keep this list minimal so a second surface can supply it cheaply.
